cost_budget.request_cap_basis: Veasel 0.79.11 has 42 maximum model rounds: 24 ordinary rounds, 3 edit-acceptance rounds, 12 bounded post-edit tool-followthrough rounds, and 3 final acceptance-review rounds. Each round allows at most 3 HTTP attempts (initial plus two bounded transient retries).
cost_budget.worst_case_cost_note: Reserves 8,192 uncached input and 2,048 output tokens for each of 126 requests at the pinned Contributor rates: USD 0.15482880 maximum. The case ceiling is USD 0.16.
